# HoneyMOM Metric Definitions

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| OEE | Availability × Performance × Quality (per machine, within the time period) |
| Availability A | Run time ÷ planned time (planned time = time period − planned downtime) |
| Performance P | Ideal cycle time × pcs produced ÷ run time |
| Quality Q | Good pcs ÷ pcs produced |
| Scrap rate | Scrap pcs ÷ pcs started (pouring + incoming material) |
| Cycle time (cycle analysis) | Rising edge → falling edge of the cycle signal (or step number returns to the first step); one value per cycle, use the median |
| Action time | Start signal change (e.g., solenoid energized) → end signal change (e.g., extended position reached), measured in milliseconds |
| Unit cycle time | Median cycle time ÷ number of parallel machines ÷ pcs per cycle; the highest value is the bottleneck workstation |
| Takt target | Set for the line (Cycle Analysis → Parameters); workstation unit cycle time ÷ takt = load |
| Slow action | Current window median is at least max(0.3 s, 20%) above the baseline (median learned from the reference window) or standard time |
| Drift | Linear trend in daily medians: last day − first day ≥ max(0.2 s, 15%), with slope > 0 and correlation coefficient ≥ 0.6 |
| Loss calculation | Extra seconds per cycle × cycles per day = seconds/day; × pcs per cycle ÷ cycle interval = pcs/day; × value per pc = CNY/day; × working days per year = CNY/year. Only losses at the bottleneck workstation actually reduce line output (affects_output) |
| Energy anomaly | A machine's hourly power consumption exceeds the median for the same hour over the past 7 days × a multiplier (default 1.3) and the excess is ≥ 1 kWh |
